rca_of_the_issue: Original cache collision occurred because destination-only requests shared the same cache tuple when category/radius/filters matched but place_query differed. The fix adds normalized place_query to the tuple. Original UI issue occurred because destination input cleared ZIP, but ZIP input did not clear destination; ZIP onChange now mirrors that clearing behavior.
